description: Use for exchange rates, customs exchange rates (customs=true) and the gold price. NBP mid, bid and ask rates of currencies against PLN (table), the history of one currency, the NBP gold price (code "XAU"), or customs exchange rates (customs=true): NBP table A rate of the penultimate Wednesday of a month, used for customs value in the next month.

code.description: ISO code, e.g. EUR, USD, CHF; "XAU" for gold. Omit for the main currencies.

customs.description: true: customs exchange rates of the current and next month. With code: one currency.

days.description: History window in days for one currency, default 90.

name: get_currency_rates
title: NBP exchange rates and gold
